name: Apple Wireless Keyboard (Bluetooth)
notes: 225-byte report descriptor of the keyboard interface of a real Apple Wireless Keyboard, recorded with hid-recorder on Linux: https://github.com/bentiss/hid-devices/blob/547829228561cf4ee613b8ad5dee0244f6b61a8c/events/keyboard/apple_05ac_0256.hid#L1-L1. Bluetooth, so the descriptor is the device's whole HID report map. The source gives the device's name, not its own USB strings, so productString is that name. The dump ends with a 0x00 byte after the last End Collection, which Linux ignores and Windows' HID parser rejects. The profile leaves it out. Other interfaces of the real device are not part of this profile.
